sections.content: You know the *indefinido* (*hablé*, *mandé*) from A2 Unit 11 and the indirect object pronouns *le* and *les* from A2 Unit 25. This lesson uses them to talk about keeping in touch. Use *con* with the person you talk to (*hablar con*, *contactar con*) and *le* for the person who receives something (*mandar un mensaje*).

items.spanish: Le mandé un mensaje a mi hermano.
items.english: I sent my brother a message.

items.spanish: Nos mantenemos en contacto por correo.
items.english: We keep in touch by email.

sections.content: Use con for the person you speak with and a for the indirect object of many communication verbs.
